newsitem.title: FRANCE: LVMH to hold 7 pct of Guinness/Grand Met.
newsitem.headline: LVMH to hold 7 pct of Guinness/Grand Met.

text.p: French drinks and luxury goods company LVMH is expected to get around seven percent of GMG Brands, the company to be formed from a planned merger of Grand Metropolitan Plc and Guinness Plc, a source close to the deal said.
LVMH currently holds a 14.2 percent stake in drinks group Guinness.
"LVMH's holding in the new group will be around seven percent," said the source, who asked not to be identified.
LVMH declined comment on the deal, referring all enquiries to a joint statement made by Guinness and Grand Met on the merger.
LVMH chairman Bernard Arnault, who is a non-executive Guinness director, voted against the plan at a board meeting on May 9, expressing his reservations on the rationale, the joint statement said.
Arnault wrote to the heads of the British firms to propose combining the wines and spirits businesses of Grand Met, Guinness and Moet Hennessy into an independent listed group, it said.
The merger will create the world's seventh largest food and drinks company, worth more than 20 billion stg.
